headline: The Sports & Hobbies Master 20
threshold: By Lesson 20, you can teach a teammate a skill and have them teach it back, deal with a lost booking or a gear shortage, say no to a risky idea without losing the group, report an injury or near miss clearly, and write the club's report in Spanish.

lessons.title: Explain the 5-1 Volleyball Rotation to a New Teammate
lessons.objective: Explain step by step how the 5-1 rotation works and why the setter moves, then have the newcomer explain it back.

words.note: Use el colocador for a man.
Short for el jugador opuesto; la opuesta for a woman.
Stress the first syllable: LÍ-be-ro.

words.en: First, look where you are in the rotation.
words.es: Primero mira dónde estás en la rotación.
words.note: Informal tú, teammate to teammate.

words.en: Then, after the serve, you switch to your position.
words.es: Luego, después del saque, cambias a tu posición.

words.en: The setter comes in from the back because she sets every ball.
words.es: La colocadora entra por detrás porque coloca todos los balones.

words.en: Stay behind the middle until we serve.
words.es: Quédate detrás del central hasta que saquemos.
words.note: Hasta que + subjunctive for a future moment.

words.en: There's only one setter, so it's different from the 6-2.
words.es: Hay una sola colocadora, por eso es distinto al 6-2.

words.en: Can you explain it back to me now, step by step?
words.es: ¿Me lo explicas tú ahora, paso a paso?

words.en: Relax, it was hard for all of us at first.
words.es: Tranquilo, a todos nos costó al principio.
words.note: Informal; use tranquila with a woman.

lessons.speaking: You are a veteran player on the team, and the AI is Rodrigo, a new teammate used to the 6-2: explain the 5-1 rotation step by step with primero, luego, porque and por eso, then have him explain it back to you.

grammar.focus: Connectors for sequence and cause (primero, luego, porque, por eso la colocadora entra por detrás)

examples.es: Primero sacamos y luego cada quien cambia a su posición.
examples.en: First we serve, and then everyone switches to their position.

examples.es: Hubo falta de posición porque te adelantaste antes del saque.
examples.en: There was an overlap fault because you moved up before the serve.

lessons.title: Reading the Hiking Club's Heat and Turnaround Rule
lessons.objective: Read the club's turnaround rule aloud and explain to a new member how it works and why it exists.

words.note: Also heard as la hora límite.
Often shortened to la máxima.

words.en: According to the club rules, we turn back at the agreed time.
words.es: Según el reglamento del club, se regresa a la hora acordada.

words.en: If the heat goes up, the route gets shortened.
words.es: Si sube el calor, se acorta la ruta.

words.en: According to today's forecast, the high is 104 degrees Fahrenheit.
words.es: Según el pronóstico de hoy, la máxima es de 104 grados Fahrenheit.

words.en: It says here that at 9:00 we turn around.
words.es: Aquí dice que a las 9:00 se da la vuelta.

words.en: If someone gets dizzy, the whole group stops.
words.es: Si alguien se marea, se detiene todo el grupo.

words.en: Marisol, the way back is hard too, and it's the hottest part.
words.es: Marisol, el regreso también cuesta, y es la parte más caliente.

words.en: It's not overdoing it: the heat builds up even if you feel fine.
words.es: No es exagerar: el calor se acumula aunque te sientas bien.
words.note: Informal tú with a fellow club member.

words.en: Do you have any questions about the rule before we head out?
words.es: ¿Tienes alguna duda sobre la regla antes de salir?

lessons.speaking: You are the club's hike leader, and the AI is Marisol, a new member: read the heat protocol aloud and explain how the turnaround works and why, using impersonal se (se regresa, se acorta) and si + present, citing the club rule and today's forecast.

grammar.focus: Impersonal se; si + present for general truths (se regresa a la hora acordada; si sube el calor, se acorta la ruta)

examples.es: Si el pronóstico marca calor extremo, se sale más temprano.
examples.en: If the forecast calls for extreme heat, we start out earlier.

examples.es: Con este calor, se camina más despacio y se descansa más.
examples.en: In this heat, you walk slower and rest more.

lessons.title: Teaching a New Rider the Pre-Ride Bike Check
lessons.objective: Coach a new club rider through the pre-ride check with clear commands, then have them do it and explain it alone.

words.note: Common in Mexico and the US; Spain says la llanta for the rim.
On a bike, the part that holds the handlebar, not 'power'.
Usual in Mexico and the US; Spain says el par de apriete.

words.en: Squeeze it hard; it shouldn't reach the handlebar.
words.es: Apriétala fuerte; no debe llegar al manubrio.
words.note: Here la refers to the brake lever (la palanca de freno).

words.en: Close it tight and check that the wheel doesn't move.
words.es: Ciérralo bien y revisa que la rueda no se mueva.

words.en: Spin the wheel and look at it head-on.
words.es: Gira la rueda y mírala de frente.

words.en: Don't crank it down; use the torque wrench.
words.es: No lo aprietes a lo bruto; usa la llave de torque.
words.note: A lo bruto is casual Mexican Spanish for 'with brute force'.

words.en: According to the manufacturer, this bolt goes to 5 Nm.
words.es: Según el fabricante, este tornillo va a 5 Nm.

words.en: If it's loose, don't touch it and let me know.
words.es: Si está suelto, no lo toques y avísame.

words.en: The pressure is printed on the tire; read it before you pump it up.
words.es: La presión viene en la llanta; léela antes de inflarla.

words.en: Now do it on your own and explain it to me.
words.es: Ahora hazlo tú solo y explícamelo.

lessons.speaking: You are the club's ride leader, and the AI is Iván, a new rider: teach the brake, wheel and bolt check with commands like revísalo, apriétalo según el fabricante and no lo toques, then have him do the check and explain it alone.

grammar.focus: Commands with object pronouns (revísalo, apriétalo según el fabricante, no lo toques si está suelto)

examples.es: Apriétalo con la llave de torque, según el fabricante.
examples.en: Tighten it with the torque wrench, per the manufacturer.

examples.es: Si el freno roza, no lo ajustes tú; enséñamelo.
examples.en: If the brake rubs, don't adjust it yourself; show it to me.

lessons.title: Read the Kayak Capacity Plate Before We Launch
lessons.objective: Read a rental kayak's capacity plate and life-jacket label and explain what must be checked before launching.

words.note: The PFD; often just el chaleco.
Mexican and US usage.

words.en: Before loading the kayak, we have to read the plate.
words.es: Antes de cargar el kayak, hay que leer la placa.

words.en: The plate says the maximum is 450 pounds.
words.es: La placa dice que el máximo es de 450 libras.

words.en: Adding us, the cooler and the dog, what does it come to?
words.es: Sumando nosotros, la hielera y el perro, ¿cuánto nos da?

words.en: If we're over the limit, the cooler stays in the truck.
words.es: Si pasamos el límite, la hielera se queda en la troca.
words.note: Informal; troca is the US/Mexican word for pickup truck.

words.en: After you buckle your vest, I'll check it.
words.es: Después de abrocharte el chaleco, te lo reviso.

words.en: We have to check the vest's label before you put it on.
words.es: Hay que revisar la etiqueta del chaleco antes de ponértelo.

words.en: Excuse me, do you rent dog life jackets?
words.note: Formal, to the dock staff.

lessons.speaking: You are Tomás's paddling partner, and the AI is Tomás, who wants to bring a cooler and his dog: read the capacity plate and life-jacket label aloud and explain what to check before launching, using antes de / después de + infinitive and hay que.

grammar.focus: Antes de / después de + infinitive; hay que (antes de cargar el kayak hay que leer la placa; después de abrocharte el chaleco, lo reviso)

examples.es: Antes de subir la hielera, hay que sumar la carga total.
examples.en: Before putting the cooler in, we have to add up the total load.

examples.es: Después de cargar todo, hay que ver la línea de flotación.
examples.en: After loading everything, we have to check the waterline.

lessons.title: Softball Field Double-Booked on Tournament Morning
lessons.objective: Tell the park coordinator what happened with the booking and propose realistic alternatives for the team's games.

words.note: Common in Mexico and the US; Spain says la reserva.
Many players in Mexico and the US also say el ampáyer.

words.en: We made the reservation in March and paid the deposit.
words.es: Hicimos la reservación en marzo y pagamos el depósito.

words.en: Nobody told us there was a change.
words.es: Nadie nos avisó que había un cambio.
words.note: Preterite for the single event (avisó), imperfect for the background (había).

words.en: Here's the screenshot of the confirmation email.
words.es: Aquí tiene la captura de pantalla del correo de confirmación.
words.note: Formal: aquí tiene, for the coordinator.

words.en: Could you search by the confirmation number, please?
words.es: ¿Podría buscar con el número de confirmación, por favor?
words.note: Formal.

words.en: We could use field B until 11:00.
words.es: Podríamos usar el campo B hasta las 11:00.

words.en: Would it be possible to move our first game by an hour?
words.es: ¿Sería posible mover nuestro primer juego una hora?
words.note: Formal.

words.en: Guys, keep warming up in the outfield; we've almost got it sorted.
words.es: Muchachos, sigan calentando en el jardín; ya casi lo arreglamos.
words.note: Informal, to your own team.

lessons.speaking: You are the team captain, and the AI is Benito Salas, the park coordinator: explain when and how you booked the diamond using the preterite and imperfect (cuando llegamos, ya calentaban), show your proof, and propose alternatives with podríamos and ¿sería posible…?

grammar.focus: Preterite vs imperfect; conditional for the proposal (cuando llegamos, otro equipo ya calentaba; podríamos usar el campo B)

examples.es: Cuando llegamos, otro equipo ya calentaba en el diamante.
examples.en: When we arrived, another team was already warming up on the diamond.

examples.es: Podríamos jugar en el campo B si los árbitros están de acuerdo.
examples.en: We could play on field B if the umpires agree.

lessons.title: Rental Skis Run Out: Fitting the Group with Substitutes
lessons.objective: Compare substitute skis with the shop tech and explain the plan to the group so everyone gets on the hill safely.

words.note: The release setting; only the shop tech sets it, using the manufacturer's chart.

words.en: Which one is more stable, this model or the other one?
words.es: ¿Cuál es más estable, este modelo o el otro?

words.en: These are going to be shorter than the ones we reserved.
words.es: Estos van a ser más cortos que los que reservamos.

words.en: Are you going to set the bindings according to the manufacturer's chart?
words.es: ¿Usted va a ajustar las fijaciones según la tabla del fabricante?
words.note: Formal, to the technician.

words.en: Can you check the setting with my boots on?
words.es: ¿Me puede revisar el ajuste con mis botas puestas?
words.note: Formal.

words.en: First fill out the form with your weight and height.
words.es: Primero llenen el formulario con su peso y estatura.
words.note: Ustedes command, to the group.

words.en: Nobody is going to adjust bindings on their own, okay?
words.es: Nadie va a ajustar fijaciones por su cuenta, ¿de acuerdo?

words.en: Yours will be a little longer, but softer.
words.es: Los tuyos serán un poco más largos, pero más suaves.
words.note: Informal, to a friend.

words.en: If you don't feel confident, we'll go down the green run first.
words.es: Si no te sientes seguro, bajaremos primero por la pista verde.

lessons.speaking: You are the club's trip organizer, and the AI is Ingrid Solís, the rental tech: compare the substitute skis with más… que and tan… como, confirm she will set each binding by the manufacturer's chart, and tell the group the plan using ir a and the future.

grammar.focus: Future and ir a; comparisons (estos van a ser más cortos que los tuyos; el técnico los ajustará según la tabla del fabricante)

examples.es: Los esquís de Carla serán tan largos como los míos.
examples.en: Carla's skis will be as long as mine.

examples.es: Ingrid ajustará cada fijación según la tabla del fabricante.
examples.en: Ingrid will set each binding according to the manufacturer's chart.

lessons.title: Trail Ranger Stops Our Group at the Closed Bridge
lessons.objective: Answer a ranger's questions about the group, permit and timing, and agree on the route change with accurate numbers.

words.note: Same form for a man or a woman: el guardaparques, la guardaparques.

words.en: We went in at 7:15 at the north trailhead.
words.es: Entramos a las 7:15 por el inicio del sendero norte.

words.en: There were 14 of us going in, and there are still 14.
words.es: Éramos 14 al entrar, y seguimos siendo 14.
El número de permiso termina en 4-8-2.
words.note: Read permit digits one by one: cuatro, ocho, dos.

words.en: We got to the bridge 10 minutes ago and nobody crossed.
words.es: Llegamos al puente hace 10 minutos y nadie cruzó.

words.en: Sorry, I made a mistake: we left the parking lot at 7:05.
words.es: Perdón, me equivoqué: salimos del estacionamiento a las 7:05.

words.en: Let me repeat the numbers for you: 14 people, entry at 7:15.
words.es: Le repito los números: 14 personas, entrada a las 7:15.
words.note: Formal: le repito, to the ranger.

words.en: How long does the detour take to the parking lot?
words.es: ¿Cuánto tiempo toma el desvío hasta el estacionamiento?

words.en: Nobody crosses; the bridge is closed for structural damage.
words.es: Nadie cruza; el puente está cerrado por daño estructural.
words.note: To your group: firm and short.

lessons.speaking: You are the hike leader, and the AI is ranger Esteban Ruiz: answer his questions about your group, entry time and permit in the preterite with exact numbers (entramos a las 7:15, éramos 14), keep everyone off the bridge, and agree on the detour.

grammar.focus: Preterite narration; numbers under pressure (entramos a las siete y cuarto, éramos catorce, el permiso termina en 4-8-2)

examples.es: Salimos del estacionamiento a las 6:50 y caminamos 3 millas.
examples.en: We left the parking lot at 6:50 and hiked 3 miles.

examples.es: 2 compañeros se quedaron atrás y llegaron a las 9:40.
examples.en: 2 members fell behind and arrived at 9:40.

lessons.title: Saying No to the Bridge Jump on the River Trip
lessons.objective: Refuse a friend's risky jump firmly but kindly, give the reasons and offer a safer plan the group accepts.

words.note: Mexican usage; echarse un clavado means to dive in.

words.en: Julián, don't climb onto the railing, I'm asking you.
words.es: Julián, no te subas al barandal, te lo pido.
words.note: Informal tú negative command.

words.en: I don't recommend anyone jumping in with the river this churned up.
words.es: No recomiendo que nadie se tire con el río así de revuelto.

words.en: The sign says jumping off the bridge is prohibited.
words.es: El letrero dice que está prohibido saltar del puente.

words.en: I'm not trying to rain on your parade; it's about your neck.
words.es: No es por aguarte la fiesta; es por tu cuello.
words.note: Informal Mexican: aguar la fiesta means to spoil the fun.

words.en: If someone gets hurt here, help takes a long time.
words.es: Si alguien se lastima aquí, la ayuda tarda mucho.

words.en: Please don't climb onto the bridge; let's keep floating instead.
words.es: No se suban al puente, por favor; mejor sigamos flotando.
words.note: Ustedes negative command, to the group.

words.en: Farther down there's a swimming hole where you can swim.
words.es: Más abajo hay una poza donde sí se puede nadar.

words.en: How about we stop at the swimming hole and eat there?
words.es: ¿Qué les parece si paramos en la poza y comemos ahí?

lessons.speaking: You are the trip organizer, and the AI is your longtime friend Julián Ortega, who wants to jump from the old railroad bridge: say no firmly but kindly with negative commands (no saltes) and no recomiendo que + subjunctive, give your reasons, and offer a safer plan.

grammar.focus: Negative commands; subjunctive after no recomiendo que (no saltes, no recomiendo que nadie salte sin saber la profundidad)

examples.es: No saltes, Julián; nadie ha revisado la profundidad.
examples.en: Don't jump, Julián; nobody has checked the depth.

examples.es: No recomiendo que nadie salte sin conocer el fondo.
examples.en: I don't recommend that anyone jump without knowing the bottom.

lessons.title: Feedback for a Co-Captain Who Yells at Rookies
lessons.objective: Give a co-captain honest, specific feedback on sideline behavior and agree on how to coach new players.

words.note: For a woman: la cocapitana.
Mixed or male group: los novatos; all women: las novatas.
The defender guarding the thrower in ultimate.

words.en: Germán, do you have a minute to talk privately?
words.es: Germán, ¿tienes un minuto para hablar a solas?
words.note: Informal: tú between co-captains.

words.en: I want you to encourage the rookies, not yell at them.
words.es: Quiero que animes a los novatos, no que les grites.
words.note: Querer que + subjunctive; keep the personal a before people.

words.en: I recommend you explain the play to them during the timeout.
words.es: Te recomiendo que les expliques la jugada en el tiempo fuera.

words.en: Two new players told me they might not come anymore.
words.es: Dos jugadoras nuevas me dijeron que a lo mejor ya no vienen.

words.en: I know you do it because you want to win.
words.es: Sé que lo haces porque quieres ganar.

words.en: I'd rather you tell me if something bothers you.
words.es: Prefiero que me digas a mí si algo te molesta.

words.en: How about we correct mistakes after the game?
words.es: ¿Qué te parece si corregimos los errores después del juego?

words.en: I hope they come back next Saturday.
words.es: Ojalá que regresen el próximo sábado.
words.note: Ojalá (que) always takes the subjunctive.

lessons.speaking: You are a co-captain, and the AI is Germán Vidal, your fellow co-captain: give him honest, specific feedback on his shouting at the rookies and agree on how to coach them, using quiero que…, te recomiendo que… and te pido que… with the subjunctive.

grammar.focus: Present subjunctive after wishes and recommendations (quiero que los animes; te recomiendo que les expliques la jugada)

examples.es: Quiero que les hables con calma en la línea lateral.
examples.en: I want you to talk to them calmly on the sideline.

examples.es: Te pido que no le grites a nadie durante el punto.
examples.en: I'm asking you not to yell at anyone during the point.

lessons.title: Settling a Disputed Line Call in the Doubles Ladder
lessons.objective: Report what each player said happened and guide both to a fair decision under the ladder's rules.

words.note: For a woman: la organizadora.
For a woman: la testigo.
In doubles, la pareja is your partner, man or woman.
Cantar fuera = to call the ball out.

words.en: Patricia said the ball had landed well out.
words.es: Patricia dijo que la bola había caído fuera por mucho.
words.note: Reported past: dijo que + pluperfect (había caído).

words.en: Fernando says he saw it on the line.
words.es: Fernando dice que la vio sobre la línea.

words.en: Where were you when the ball bounced?
words.es: ¿Dónde estaba usted cuando botó la bola?
words.note: Formal. Imperfect estaba sets the scene; preterite botó is the event.

words.en: Your partner told me she hadn't seen the ball clearly.
words.es: Su pareja me dijo que no había visto bien la bola.

words.en: No one is saying anyone lied; you both saw different things.
words.es: Nadie está diciendo que mintió; los dos vieron cosas distintas.

words.en: I told Fernando that you called it out right away.
words.es: Le dije a Fernando que usted cantó fuera enseguida.
words.note: Formal.

words.en: Under our rules, if there's doubt, the ball is in.
words.es: Según nuestras reglas, si hay duda, la bola es buena.

words.en: Do you both think replaying the point is fair?

lessons.speaking: You are the ladder organizer, and the AI plays Patricia Lozano and Fernando Aguirre: ask each what they saw, relay each version to the other with reported speech (dijo que había caído…) and the imperfect for background, then guide them to a fair decision under the ladder rules.

grammar.focus: Reported speech; imperfect for background (Patricia dijo que la bola había caído fuera; el sol le daba en la cara a Fernando)

examples.es: Fernando me contó que tenía el sol de frente y no veía bien la línea.
examples.en: Fernando told me he had the sun in his eyes and couldn't see the line well.

examples.es: Patricia explicó que estaba junto a la red y que la bola había botado fuera.
examples.en: Patricia explained that she was by the net and that the ball had bounced out.

lessons.title: Rallying the Dragon Boat Crew After Three Losses
lessons.objective: Lift a discouraged crew, name what went well and commit to concrete changes for the next practice and race.

words.note: For a woman: la tamborilera.
Same form for a woman: la timonel.
Dragon boats use a single-blade canalete, not a remo.
La moral = team spirit; el moral is a mulberry tree.
For a woman: la remera.

words.en: Chin up, team! Our timing was much better today.
words.es: ¡Ánimo, equipo! Hoy la sincronización estuvo mucho mejor.

words.en: We lost by less than 2 seconds; we're almost there.
words.es: Perdimos por menos de 2 segundos; ya casi estamos.

words.en: On Tuesday we'll practice the first 10 strokes.
words.es: El martes practicaremos las primeras 10 paladas.

words.en: Listen to the drum and all come in together.
words.es: Escuchen el tambor y entren todos juntos.
words.note: Plural ustedes command to the crew.

words.en: I'll talk to the steerer about the final stretch.
words.es: Yo hablaré con el timonel sobre la recta final.

words.en: Nora, don't leave yet; we need you on the crew.
words.es: Nora, no te vayas todavía; te necesitamos en la tripulación.
words.note: Informal: tú with a teammate.

words.en: What do you need from us to stay?
This doesn't end here; we're going to get better together.
words.es: Esto no se termina aquí; vamos a mejorar juntos.

lessons.speaking: You are the crew captain, and the AI is your crew, including veteran paddler Nora Fuentes: name what went well today, commit to concrete changes with the future (practicaremos, llegaremos), respond to Nora, and encourage everyone with ¡ánimo! and vamos a lograrlo.

grammar.focus: Future for commitments; encouragement register (el jueves practicaremos las salidas; lo vamos a lograr juntos, ¡ánimo!)

examples.es: El sábado llegaremos una hora antes y calentaremos juntos.
examples.en: On Saturday we'll arrive an hour early and warm up together.

examples.es: Nora, la próxima vez remarás en la primera fila y marcarás el ritmo.
examples.en: Nora, next time you'll paddle in the front row and set the pace.

lessons.title: New Court Rules Explained to Four Different People
lessons.objective: Explain the club's new court-booking rules to four listeners in the right register and check each one understood.

words.note: For a woman: la tutora legal.
For a woman or a company: la patrocinadora.
For a man: el presidente del club.

words.en: Diego, now you book through the app, not on the sheet anymore.
words.es: Diego, ahora reservas por la aplicación, ya no en la hoja.
words.note: Informal: tú with a teammate.

words.en: Mrs. Rivas, I'd like to show you how the waitlist works.
words.es: Sra. Rivas, quisiera mostrarle cómo funciona la lista de espera.
words.note: Formal. Quisiera softens a request more than quiero.

words.en: Mr. Montes, would it be all right if I explain the sponsor schedule?
words.es: Señor Montes, ¿le parece bien si le explico el horario para patrocinadores?
words.note: Formal.

words.en: Mr. Bravo, your son needs the signed authorization to book.
words.es: Señor Bravo, su hijo necesita la autorización firmada para reservar.
words.note: Formal.

words.en: Under the new rules, you cancel with 24 hours' notice.
words.es: Según las reglas nuevas, se cancela con 24 horas de aviso.

words.en: Could you tell me in your own words how you cancel?
words.es: ¿Me podrías decir con tus palabras cómo cancelas?
words.note: Informal softener: ¿me podrías…?

words.en: Could you repeat back to me when open play starts, please?
words.es: ¿Podría repetirme cuándo empieza el juego abierto, por favor?
words.note: Formal softener: ¿podría…? with usted.

words.en: Excuse me, is the part about the penalty clear?
words.es: Disculpe, ¿quedó claro lo de la penalización?
words.note: Formal.

lessons.speaking: You are the club member explaining the new booking rules, and the AI plays Diego, Sra. Rivas, Sr. Montes and Sr. Bravo: explain the rules to each, switching between tú and usted, soften with quisiera explicarle and ¿me podrías…?, and ask each one to say the rule back.

grammar.focus: Usted / tú switching; softeners (quisiera explicarle, ¿me podrías repetir cómo reservas?)

examples.es: Sra. Rivas, ¿me permite explicarle el cambio en las horas pico?
examples.en: Mrs. Rivas, may I explain the change to peak hours to you?

examples.es: Diego, ¿me podrías decir qué pasa si no llegas a tu reserva?
examples.en: Diego, could you tell me what happens if you don't show up for your booking?

lessons.title: Ankle Injury on the Descent: Writing the Club Report
lessons.objective: Tell the club's safety officer exactly what happened and when, then complete the injury report form.

words.note: Mexican/US usage; reporte is more common than informe.
Standard heading on Spanish incident forms.

words.en: Raúl, do you have a moment to go over what happened with Ximena?
words.es: Raúl, ¿tienes un rato para repasar lo de Ximena?
words.note: Informal: tú with a fellow club member.

words.en: At 11:40 Ximena twisted her ankle on the way down.
words.es: A las 11:40 Ximena se torció el tobillo bajando.

words.en: Ten minutes later we called 911 with the GPS coordinates.
words.es: Diez minutos después llamamos al 911 con las coordenadas GPS.

words.en: Meanwhile, I stayed with her and we didn't let her walk.
words.es: Mientras tanto, la acompañé y no la dejamos caminar.

words.en: The rescuers arrived at 1:15 and brought her down.
words.es: Los rescatistas llegaron a la 1:15 y la bajaron.

words.en: I don't know the exact time; I'll confirm it with the group.
words.es: No sé la hora exacta; lo confirmo con el grupo.

words.en: In the report I only put what I saw, without guessing.
words.es: En el reporte pongo solo lo que vi, sin adivinar.

words.en: Could you confirm that you received the incident report, please?
words.es: ¿Me confirma que recibió el reporte de incidente, por favor?
words.note: Formal: usted, for the insurance company.

lessons.speaking: You are the hike leader, and the AI is Raúl Medina, the club's safety officer: walk him through Ximena's injury in order using time markers like a las…, diez minutos después and mientras tanto, then confirm the details for the incident form.

grammar.focus: Past narration with time markers (a las 11:40 Ximena se torció el tobillo; diez minutos después llamamos; mientras tanto la acompañé)

examples.es: A las 11:40 Ximena se torció el tobillo en el descenso.
examples.en: At 11:40 Ximena twisted her ankle on the descent.

examples.es: Mientras esperábamos a los rescatistas, la acompañé y le di agua.
examples.en: While we waited for the rescuers, I stayed with her and gave her water.

lessons.title: Close Call at the Auto-Belay: A No-Blame Talk
lessons.objective: Talk through a near miss calmly with the climber and staff, without blame, and agree on one concrete change.

words.note: Many US gyms just say el auto-belay.
Standard climbing word for a route.
In a no-blame review, talk about la causa, not la culpa.

words.en: Camila, nobody is blaming you; we just want to understand what happened.
words.es: Camila, nadie te está culpando; solo queremos entender qué pasó.
words.note: Informal: tú with a club teammate.

words.en: You almost went up without clipping into the auto-belay.
words.es: Por poco subes sin engancharte al autoasegurador.

words.en: You could have fallen from the top of the route.
words.es: Podrías haber caído desde lo alto de la vía.

words.en: If we had done the buddy check, we would have seen it.
words.es: Si hubiéramos hecho la revisión entre compañeros, lo habríamos visto.

words.en: What was going on right before you started climbing?
words.es: ¿Qué estaba pasando justo antes de que empezaras a subir?

words.en: Mateo, how did you see it from the floor?
words.es: Mateo, ¿usted cómo lo vio desde el piso?
words.note: Formal: usted with gym staff.

words.en: I suggest we check each other's carabiner before every route.
words.es: Propongo que nos revisemos el mosquetón antes de cada vía.

words.en: Thanks for telling us; this is how we all learn.
words.es: Gracias por contarlo; así aprendemos todos.

lessons.speaking: You are the club's climbing lead, and the AI is Camila, with floor staff member Mateo: talk through her near miss calmly using por poco, podría haber and si hubiéramos…, habríamos…, without blame, and agree on one concrete check.

grammar.focus: Casi, por poco, podría haber; si clauses (por poco sube sin enganchar; podría haber caído; si hubiéramos revisado, lo habríamos visto)

examples.es: Por poco sube sin enganchar el mosquetón.
examples.en: She almost started climbing without clipping the carabiner.

examples.es: Si hubiéramos revisado juntos, lo habríamos visto antes.
examples.en: If we had checked together, we would have seen it sooner.

lessons.title: Thunder Heard: Clearing the Soccer Fields by Radio
lessons.objective: Give short, clear radio commands to clear the fields and explain when play can resume under league rules.

words.note: In Mexico the two-way radio is el radio.
Open metal bleachers are not a safe shelter.
Check the league policy for when the count restarts.

words.en: Gabriela, Luis, stop the games now; there was thunder.
words.es: Gabriela, Luis, paren los partidos ya; se oyó un trueno.
words.note: Ustedes command to the referees.
Informal radio talk; copiar means to hear clearly.

words.en: Nobody stays in the bleachers or under the trees.
words.es: Nadie se queda en las gradas ni debajo de los árboles.

words.en: The league policy says: 30 minutes without thunder.
words.es: La política de la liga dice: 30 minutos sin truenos.

words.en: According to the policy, if it thunders again, the count will start over.
words.es: Según la política, si truena otra vez, el conteo empezará de nuevo.

words.en: Captain, I understand, but the rule is for everyone.
words.es: Capitán, lo entiendo, pero la regla es para todos.
words.note: Formal and calm with an upset captain.

words.en: If there's no more thunder, we'll resume at 4:30.
words.es: Si no hay más truenos, reanudaremos a las 4:30.

lessons.speaking: You are the field marshal, and the AI is referee Gabriela Peña on the radio, then a team captain: clear the fields with short commands like ¡todos a los vehículos, ya!, and explain the restart with si + present → future and the league's written wait time.

grammar.focus: Si + present → future; short radio or phone commands (si se oye otro trueno, suspenderemos; ¡todos a los autos, ya!)

examples.es: Si se oye otro trueno, suspenderemos todo el torneo.
examples.en: If there's more thunder, we'll suspend the whole tournament.

examples.es: Si el cielo se despeja, reanudaremos según la política de la liga.
examples.en: If the sky clears, we'll resume according to the league's policy.

lessons.title: Insurance Auditor Reviews Our Waivers and First-Aid Kit
lessons.objective: Walk an auditor through the club's safety procedures in formal Spanish and answer questions about forms and privacy.

words.note: In Mexico also la carta responsiva.
Mexican usage: archivero for a file cabinet.

words.en: Ms. Navarro, I'd be glad to show you our procedures.
words.es: Licenciada Navarro, con gusto le muestro nuestros procedimientos.
words.note: Formal: Licenciada is a respectful title for a graduate in Mexico.

words.en: Waivers are signed before each season.
words.es: Las exenciones se firman antes de cada temporada.

words.en: Medical forms are kept under lock and key in the office.
words.es: Los formularios médicos se guardan bajo llave en la oficina.

words.en: The first-aid kit is checked every month and the date is recorded.
words.es: El botiquín se revisa cada mes y se anota la fecha.

words.en: You're right; those two forms shouldn't have been in that folder.
words.es: Tiene razón; esos dos formularios no debían estar en esa carpeta.

words.en: They'll be moved to the locked file cabinet today.
words.es: Hoy mismo se mueven al archivero con llave.

words.en: Would you like me to email you a copy of the inventory?
words.es: ¿Desea que le envíe una copia del inventario por correo?

words.en: What deadline do you give us for the corrective action?
words.es: ¿Qué plazo nos da para la medida correctiva?

lessons.speaking: You are the league's safety coordinator, and the AI is insurance auditor Lic. Beatriz Navarro: walk her through waivers, emergency contacts and the first-aid kit in formal usted Spanish, describing procedures with passive se (se firman, se guardan, se revisan).

grammar.focus: Formal register; passive se for procedures (se firman las exenciones antes de cada temporada; los datos médicos se guardan bajo llave)

examples.es: Los contactos de emergencia se actualizan al inscribirse cada temporada.
examples.en: Emergency contacts are updated at registration each season.

examples.es: Los datos médicos se guardan bajo llave y no se comparten.
examples.en: Medical data is kept under lock and key and is not shared.

lessons.title: Writing the Backpacking Trip Report for the Club Board
lessons.objective: Write a clear, formal trip report covering attendance, route changes, gear issues and recommendations.

words.note: Informe sounds more formal than reporte; use it for the board.
Elena is a woman: la presidenta. For a man: el presidente.
Common Mexican word for a landslide or a washed-out trail.
Mexican usage; tiendas de campaña is also understood.
Followed by a noun: debido al deslave (a + el = al).

words.en: Dear Ms. Paredes: I am sending you the trip report.
words.es: Estimada Sra. Paredes: le envío el informe del viaje.
words.note: Formal written opening; use a colon after the greeting.

words.en: First, 11 of the 12 registered members attended.
words.es: En primer lugar, asistieron 11 de los 12 inscritos.

words.en: Due to a washout, we had to take the alternate route.
words.es: Debido a un deslave, tuvimos que tomar la ruta alterna.

words.en: Therefore, we covered 4 more miles than planned.
words.es: Por lo tanto, recorrimos 4 millas más de lo previsto.

words.en: Two borrowed tents leaked through the seams.
words.es: Dos casas de campaña prestadas tuvieron filtraciones por las costuras.

words.en: It should be noted that no one was injured during the trip.
words.es: Cabe señalar que nadie resultó herido durante el viaje.
words.note: Very formal; typical of written reports read at meetings.

words.en: We recommend checking borrowed gear before every trip.
words.es: Se recomienda revisar el equipo prestado antes de cada salida.
words.note: Impersonal se keeps the report neutral and formal.

words.en: In conclusion, the trip was a success despite the setbacks.
words.es: En conclusión, el viaje fue un éxito pese a los imprevistos.

lessons.speaking: You are the trip leader, and the AI is board chair Elena Paredes: present your formal trip report on attendance, the reroute, the leaking tents and your recommendations, using connectors like en primer lugar, debido a, por lo tanto, cabe señalar que and en conclusión.

grammar.focus: Written register; report connectors (en primer lugar, debido a, por lo tanto, cabe señalar que, en conclusión)

examples.es: Debido al deslave, el grupo cambió de ruta el segundo día.
examples.en: Due to the washout, the group changed routes on the second day.

examples.es: Por lo tanto, la junta debería revisar las casas de campaña del club.
examples.en: Therefore, the board should inspect the club's tents.

lessons.title: Group Chat and Calls: Moving the Charity Ride a Day
lessons.objective: Announce a date change by text, call a sponsor and leave a voicemail, all with polite, clear phone Spanish.

words.note: Rodada is the common Mexican word for a group bike ride.
For a woman: la mecánica.

words.en: Hi everyone: because of the storm, the ride moves to Sunday.
words.es: Hola a todos: por la tormenta, la rodada se cambia al domingo.
words.note: Informal group-chat message.

words.en: Same time and same meeting point: 7:00 at the park.
words.es: Misma hora y mismo punto de reunión: 7:00 en el parque.
words.note: Short, verbless lines are normal in chat.

words.en: Good evening, am I speaking with Mr. Óscar Benítez?
words.es: Buenas noches, ¿hablo con el señor Óscar Benítez?
words.note: Formal phone opening.

words.en: Could you confirm whether the support van is free on Sunday?
words.es: ¿Podría confirmarme si la camioneta de apoyo está libre el domingo?
words.note: Formal; the conditional podría softens the request.

words.en: Would it be all right if we picked up the van at 6:30?
words.es: ¿Le parecería bien que pasáramos por la camioneta a las 6:30?
words.note: Formal; conditional + past subjunctive.

words.en: I would appreciate it if you called me before 9:00.
words.es: Le agradecería que me llamara antes de las 9:00.
words.note: Formal; agradecería que takes the past subjunctive.

words.en: Sofía, I'm leaving you this message because the ride changed dates.
words.es: Sofía, te dejo este mensaje porque la rodada cambió de fecha.
words.note: Informal voicemail to a fellow rider.

words.en: Call me or text me when you hear this, okay?
words.es: Márcame o mándame un mensaje cuando lo escuches, ¿sí?
words.note: Informal; marcar is common Mexican usage for calling.

lessons.speaking: You are the ride organizer, and the AI is bike-shop sponsor Óscar Benítez on the phone: explain that the charity ride moves to Sunday and ask him to confirm the support van, using polite forms like ¿podría confirmarme...? and le agradecería que...

grammar.focus: Phone and text conventions; conditional politeness (¿podría confirmarme la camioneta?, le agradecería que me llamara)

examples.es: ¿Podría confirmarme la camioneta para el domingo?
examples.en: Could you confirm the van for Sunday?

examples.es: Le agradecería que me devolviera la llamada esta noche.
examples.en: I would appreciate it if you returned my call tonight.

lessons.title: End-of-Season Court Walkthrough with the Park Manager
lessons.objective: Walk the courts with the facility manager, explain wear and repairs, and negotiate next season's booking terms.

words.note: For a woman: la administradora.

words.en: You're right, the tear in the net is our responsibility.
words.es: Tiene razón, la rotura de la red es responsabilidad nuestra.
words.note: Formal; admitting fault first makes the negotiation easier.

words.en: The antenna was already loose when we started; we have photos.
words.es: La antena ya estaba floja cuando empezamos; tenemos fotos.

words.en: Would you return our deposit as long as we replace the net?
words.es: ¿Nos devolverían el depósito siempre que repongamos la red?
words.note: Siempre que + present subjunctive = as long as.

words.en: We would pay for the antenna provided it comes out of the deposit.
words.es: Pagaríamos la antena con tal de que se descuente del depósito.

words.en: We would book again provided you keep our time slot.
words.es: Reservaríamos otra vez con tal de que respeten nuestro horario.

words.en: We would sign today if you guaranteed us Tuesdays at 6:00.
words.es: Firmaríamos hoy si nos garantizara los martes a las 6:00.
words.note: Si + past subjunctive with the conditional, never si + present.

words.en: Could you send us the repair cost in writing?
words.es: ¿Podría mandarnos por escrito el costo de la reparación?
words.note: Formal.

lessons.speaking: You are the club's court captain, and the AI is park manager Hugo Serrano: walk the courts with him, explain the wear and repairs, and negotiate the deposit and next year's time slot using the conditional with siempre que and con tal de que plus the subjunctive.

grammar.focus: Conditional; subjunctive in conditions (nos devolverían el depósito siempre que repongamos la red; reservaríamos otra vez con tal de que...)

examples.es: Nos devolverían el depósito siempre que repongamos la red antes de abril.
examples.en: They would return our deposit as long as we replace the net before April.

examples.es: Reservaríamos los martes otra vez con tal de que no suba el precio.
examples.en: We would book Tuesdays again provided that the price doesn't go up.

lessons.title: Capstone: Race Director for the Club's Trail Run
lessons.objective: Lead a full race day in Spanish: brief volunteers, solve problems, handle an injury, meet the official and report.

words.note: For a woman: la directora de carrera.
For a woman: la encargada; a mixed group: los encargados.
The last runner on course, who checks that no one is left behind.
Sra. Gallardo is a woman: la oficial. For a man: el oficial.

words.en: Rosa, tie the ribbon at eye level, like this.
words.es: Rosa, amarra la cinta a la altura de los ojos, así.
words.note: Informal tú command to a volunteer.

words.en: Put someone at the junction until the sign arrives.
words.es: Pongan a alguien en la bifurcación hasta que llegue el letrero.
words.note: Ustedes command; hasta que + subjunctive for a future moment.

words.en: Andrés, Paula, how about we split the water in half?
words.es: Andrés, Paula, ¿qué les parece si dividimos el agua a la mitad?

words.en: Martín, don't move yet; where does it hurt?
words.es: Martín, no se mueva todavía; ¿dónde le duele?
words.note: Formal usted with an injured runner you don't know.

words.en: Runner down at mile 3; send the paramedics.
words.es: Corredor caído en la milla 3; manden a los paramédicos.
words.note: Personal a before people: manden a los paramédicos.

words.en: Ms. Gallardo, according to the permit, the limit is 300 runners.
words.es: Sra. Gallardo, según el permiso, el límite es de 300 corredores.
words.note: Formal; name the source of the number.

words.en: 287 runners finished, all before the cutoff time.
words.es: Llegaron 287 corredores, todos antes del tiempo de corte.

words.en: In summary, there was only one minor injury, treated by the paramedics.
words.es: En resumen, solo hubo un herido leve, atendido por los paramédicos.
words.note: Formal written register for the board.

lessons.speaking: You are the race director, and the AI plays your volunteers and officials: train Rosa Delgado on course marking, brief the aid-station leads, answer permit officer Sra. Gallardo and text the board your report, using commands, conditional proposals, the subjunctive and past narration.

grammar.focus: Capstone: integrating the Master 20 grammar (connectors, commands, conditional proposals, subjunctive, past narration, formal register)

examples.es: Debido a que faltaba un letrero, pusimos a un voluntario en la bifurcación.
examples.en: Because a sign was missing, we put a volunteer at the junction.

examples.es: Le pido que no se levante hasta que lo revisen los paramédicos.
examples.en: I ask you not to get up until the paramedics check you.
